research.competitor_pattern: Public ChatGPT style/beauty GPTs remain largely one-shot assistants, while adjacent 2026 styling apps increasingly compete on persistent closet/profile/history context, saved inspiration, try-on and planning workflows.
research.public_signals: FreshFit markets a closet-aware stylist that learns colors/fits/silhouettes and saved inspiration; Clovy emphasizes outfit history/calendar; Flaired emphasizes selfie/body/wardrobe/style-reference context and saved/shareable try-on; Alta centers a digital closet, personalized daily outfits and planning. Celebrity-lookalike contests remain highly shareable social formats.
research.expansion_opportunity: Style Evolution remains the strongest adjacent expansion: consented longitudinal style profile + saved looks/recommendations + feedback + shareable comparison/inspiration, reusing the Rate My Face account layer while avoiding real-person identification claims.

daily_reports.summary: Implemented Stripe-hosted subscription checkout, billing portal, webhook-driven entitlements, and premium-gated persistent memory. Production activation still requires Stripe configuration verification.
Verified Personal Network deployment and aligned the credit-metered Action architecture. Retention, GPT usage, Associates conversion and end-to-end credit metrics remained unmeasured.
Production auth/database/Stripe configuration was healthy but purchase closure remained absent. Personal Network recommendation-table collision was fixed and bootstrap/founder credits were merged.

Account Learning is now materially active: 1 profile, 2 interactions, 2 personal recommendations and 8 metered credits consumed from a 100-credit bootstrap, leaving 92. Compare TEST persisted 1 job/result while public Compare remains disabled. Stripe still has zero Checkout Sessions and lifetime purchased credits remain 0, so monetization closure is not yet proven. RLS is now enabled across listed public tables; remaining security advisor findings concern server/ops tables without policies and leaked-password protection. Latest DB fail-fast deployment is READY with no runtime errors observed in the first 10 minutes.
